title: A Message to Cush and a Gift for Zion
description: A prophetic oracle concerning the land beyond the rivers of Cush, where messengers travel in papyrus boats to a tall and feared people. The Lord waits quietly like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest, before cutting off the vines and leaving them to birds of prey and wild animals. Finally, gifts from this people are brought to the Lord of hosts on Mount Zion.
